description: Spea intermontana modeled recording density; saved full-data expanded environmental model.
meaning: Recorded-cell density relative to this species' available-landscape mean; not occupancy, abundance or a physiological niche boundary.

rendering.aggregation: Physical-area-weighted arithmetic mean of exp(log_relative_density), followed by logarithmic coloring.
rendering.geographic_context: Natural Earth land, country boundaries and administrative boundaries; simplified to 6.5 km for display.

limitations: Thumbnail for a general research-project card, not a quantitative figure.
Blank exterior is unmodeled; coarse edges reflect the pre-existing analysis landscape.
Expanded 56-column model; distinct from the monthly-climate-only comparison in the public working manuscript.
No model was refitted and no new environmental prediction was made.
Full source prediction arrays remain in the research archive and are not bundled with this website.
